python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, re
p = pathlib.Path('src/codegen_support/runtime/io/user_wrapper.rs')
t = p.read_text()
for m in re.finditer(r'fn (emit_user_wrapper_\w+_linux_x86_64|emit_user_wrapper_\w+)\(', t):
    name = m.group(1)
    start = m.start()
    nxt = t.find('\nfn ', start + 1)
    nxt2 = t.find('\npub fn ', start + 1)
    end = min(x for x in (nxt, nxt2, len(t)) if x != -1)
    body = t[start:end]
    subs = body.count('sub rsp, ')
    adds = body.count('add rsp, ')
    sizes_sub = re.findall(r'sub rsp, (\d+)', body)
    sizes_add = re.findall(r'add rsp, (\d+)', body)
    if sizes_sub or sizes_add:
        print(f'{name}: sub={sizes_sub} add={sizes_add}')
